verdict.rationale: Docs describe a `/plugins` browser in Codex CLI, a `codex plugin marketplace add` command, and a marketplace.json listing plugins with categories, plus a public GitHub plugins repo showing available plugins by name/category before install. This directly supports discovering/browsing a catalog prior to installation.  missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the browse/search UI experience, and no evidence of ranking/leaderboard features (only category-based listing).
